receipt.public_excerpt: Microsoft’s admission that it shaved $3.1 billion off its net income to account for its share of OpenAI losses therefore suggests OpenAI lost about $11.5 billion during the quarter.

evidence_items.explanation: Microsoft's filing shows a large share of OpenAI losses for July–September 2025, implying an OpenAI loss of about $11.5 billion that quarter.

evidence_items.explanation: Even on the friendliest reading, without one-time conversion charges, OpenAI lost about $8 billion in 2025. The headline audited loss was $38.5 billion.
